verdict.rationale: Veo generates native dialogue audio from prompts with strong lip/audio sync. It accepts image inputs and claims character consistency, so a prompted speaking person, possibly seeded from a custom image, is plausible. However, nothing documents a script-to-presenter workflow or an avatar library, and community reports describe clips of only a few seconds with consistency still a challenge. Missing for 10: a documented paste-a-script presenter workflow, a stock avatar library, custom avatar creation, longer presenter-length output, and hands-on evidence of presenter videos.
